description: This file defines the UserRepository interface, which extends Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository to perform database operations related to UserEntity objects. It includes a custom method to find a user by their identification number.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: This interface provides data access methods for UserEntity objects, leveraging Spring Data JPA.

methods.name: findByIdentificationNumber
methods.description: A query method to retrieve a UserEntity based on the identification number, returning an Optional<UserEntity>.
